newsitem.title: PERU: Peru first half customs revenues up 3.8 percent.
newsitem.headline: Peru first half customs revenues up 3.8 percent.

text.p: Peru's customs service said its first half revenues rose 3.8 percent to $1.348 billion from $1.297 billion in the same period last year.
A statement from customs added that June revenues rose to $214.8 million from $211.4 million in the same month last year.
"These figures show the growing evolution of levels of customs revenues, despite the reductions in tariffs," the statement added.
